name: posteverywhere
description: Schedule and publish social media posts from your terminal or your agent. Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Telegram and Discord.

plugins.name: posteverywhere
plugins.description: Post, schedule and analyze social media across 11 platforms. Connects accounts via OAuth, uploads media, checks per-platform limits before composing, and reports per-destination publish results. Every command emits JSON.
